critical_function: Mineral feed for battery-material refining
source: data/reference/energy_hs6_master.csv (HS 2504.10, 2530.90, 2602, 2604, 2605); IEA Global Critical Minerals Outlook 2024; IEA, The Role of Critical Minerals in Clean Energy Transitions (2021)
notes: Natural graphite, manganese, nickel and cobalt ores and spodumene. Mining know-how is generic: process and supplier learning partly, little successor innovation.

In July 2025 China restricted export of lithium processing technology.
